finding_dispositions.evidence: The implementation now performs fail-closed exact resolved-fragment equality. Fresh tests and independent probes accepted a shared resolved fragment and rejected disjoint range, const/enum, required-object and array-item contracts; an additional active probe confirmed that a $ref with a sibling assertion is rejected. However, the gate-bound rejection test contains only the first four rejection classes and no committed $ref-sibling case, despite the normative Test Plan requiring each class individually.

Exact Node v24.19.0 binary/version/hash and oracle source hash yield runtime digest b39ecd2058fa9e40e735725100e0765077efb450d6642aeeacc3de3587c459f6; runtime/oracle digest mutation was rejected by verifier and exit binding.

The dependency record exactly binds WP01 r18 source 8b20c583…, command 07824342…, exit ce7bf823… and PASS verdict 1602b9b6…; its canonical dependency digest is f70acaaa7c362b51e714a9cb5b59c2620fbed72a2e9c7e63f2b5661976bd82e4. findings.claim: The gate-bound exact-assignability rejection suite does not mechanically cover the normative $ref-with-sibling-assertion rejection branch.
findings.evidence: The Test Plan requires shared $ref acceptance and separate rejection coverage for disjoint const/enum/range, required object members, array items and $ref sibling assertions. test_typed_edge_rejects_disjoint_constraint_object_and_array_contracts contains range, const-enum, required-object and array-items only; repository search finds no test schema containing a $ref with sibling assertions. The production branch at definition.py:755-760 currently rejects correctly, as confirmed by an independent active counterexample, but deleting or weakening that branch would not fail the gate-bound WP02 tests.
findings.required_change: Add a committed negative case with a resolvable $ref plus at least one sibling assertion to the gate-bound exact-assignability test, assert GraphDefinition loading rejects it, and retain the existing shared resolved-fragment positive case. Verify the full suite and WP02 evidence rebuild/replay fail if the sibling-rejection branch is removed or weakened.
